panels.title: Consensus Round Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Time to process an accepted ledger, from the moment consensus is reached through applying the transaction set and finalising state.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of per-round durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Flat p50 with a modest p95 gap is normal; both track network transaction load.
**Healthy range:** Roughly 3-6 seconds on mainnet.
**Watch for:** A rising p95 that pulls away from p50 means occasional slow rounds; sustained growth precedes ledger-age alarms.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::makeAcceptSpan

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.accept"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.accept"}[5m])))

panels.title: Consensus Proposals Sent Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often this node broadcasts its own consensus proposal (its candidate transaction set) to the network.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** A proposing validator emits a steady stream, roughly one per consensus round; observing-only nodes emit none.
**Healthy range:** About one proposal per round (~0.2-0.3/s on mainnet) for a proposing node.
**Watch for:** A validator that drops to zero has stopped proposing and may be unhealthy or misconfigured.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::propose

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.proposal.send"}[5m]))

panels.title: Ledger Close Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Time spent closing a ledger once consensus triggers the close, up to completion.
**How it's computed:** 95th percentile of per-close durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should sit at or just below the full round duration; a subset of overall round time.
**Healthy range:** A few seconds, tracking the ~4s mainnet ledger interval.
**Watch for:** A widening gap versus round duration points to overhead outside ledger construction.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.ledger_close"}[5m])))

panels.title: Validation Send Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often this node issues a validation confirming it has fully validated a ledger.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should closely track the ledger close rate on a healthy validator.
**Healthy range:** About one per ledger (~0.25/s on mainnet).
**Watch for:** Validations lagging closes suggests the node is falling behind on validation.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::createValidationSpan

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.validation.send"}[5m]))

panels.title: Ledger Apply Duration (doAccept)
panels.description:
**What:** Time spent applying the agreed consensus result to build the new ledger.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of per-round apply durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Scales with the size of the transaction set being applied.
**Healthy range:** Tens to a few hundred milliseconds under normal load.
**Watch for:** Spikes indicate heavy transaction sets or I/O pressure while writing ledger state.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.accept.apply"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.accept.apply"}[5m])))

panels.title: Close Time Agreement
panels.description:
**What:** Whether validators agreed on the ledger close time (agreed) or agreed to disagree and used a fallback (disagreed), per round.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of rounds split by agreement outcome over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Nearly all rounds should show agreement.
**Healthy range:** Overwhelmingly agreement; occasional disagreement is tolerable.
**Watch for:** A rising disagreement share signals clock drift or network latency across validators.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

targets.expr: sum by (close_time_correct, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="consensus.accept.apply", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Consensus Mode Over Time
panels.description:
**What:** Ledger close events split by the node's consensus mode: Proposing, Observing, Wrong Ledger, or Switched Ledger.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate per mode over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** A healthy validator stays predominantly in Proposing; a stock node stays in Observing.
**Healthy range:** Mostly one dominant mode with negligible Wrong/Switched Ledger.
**Watch for:** Frequent Wrong Ledger or Switched Ledger indicates the node is out of sync and at fork risk.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose

targets.expr: sum by (consensus_mode, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.ledger_close"}[5m]))

panels.title: Accept vs Close Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of ledgers accepted after consensus versus ledger-close events initiated.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of each over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** The two lines should overlap on a healthy network.
**Healthy range:** Both near the ledger cadence (~0.25/s on mainnet) and tracking each other.
**Watch for:** Divergence means some closes never complete the accept phase, hinting at consensus failures or timeouts.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::makeAcceptSpan, onClose

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.accept"}[5m]))

sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.ledger_close"}[5m]))

panels.title: Validation vs Close Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of validations sent versus ledger-close events.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of each over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Each validated ledger should yield one validation, so the lines should overlap.
**Healthy range:** Both near the ledger cadence and tracking each other.
**Watch for:** Validations trailing closes points to a stalled or slow validation pipeline.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::createValidationSpan, onClose

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.validation.send"}[5m]))

sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.ledger_close"}[5m]))

panels.title: Consensus Accept Duration Heatmap
panels.description:
**What:** Distribution of per-round accept durations over time, showing how round times are spread rather than just a percentile.
**How it's computed:** Counts of rounds by duration band in each 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** A tight band around the typical round time is healthy; brighter cells mark the common duration.
**Healthy range:** Concentrated near the 3-6 second mainnet round time.
**Watch for:** A second band at high durations reveals recurring slow rounds hidden by averages.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::makeAcceptSpan

targets.expr: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.accept"}[5m])) by (le)

panels.title: Close Time: Raw Proposals (Per Node)
panels.description:
**What:** Each node's raw, unrounded proposed close time at the instant it closed its ledger.
**How it's computed:** Latest raw close-time value per node, plotted per round.
**Reading it:** Compare nodes at the same round; values should cluster tightly.
**Healthy range:** All nodes within a few seconds of each other.
**Watch for:** A node consistently offset from the pack indicates local clock drift.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

panels.title: Close Time: Effective / Quantized
panels.description:
**What:** The consensus-agreed close time after rounding to the active resolution bin, i.e. the value written to the ledger header.
**How it's computed:** Latest effective close-time value per node, plotted per round.
**Reading it:** All in-agreement nodes should report the identical value each round.
**Healthy range:** Identical across agreeing nodes.
**Watch for:** Nodes reporting different effective values are not in close-time agreement for that round.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

panels.title: Close Time Vote Bins & Resolution
panels.description:
**What:** Number of distinct close-time vote buckets and the current close-time resolution, per round.
**How it's computed:** Latest bin count and resolution value plotted per round, per node.
**Reading it:** Fewer bins and finer resolution mean tighter agreement; resolution coarsens automatically when validators disagree.
**Healthy range:** Few bins with fine (about 10s) resolution during healthy operation.
**Watch for:** Many bins or resolution jumping to its coarse ceiling signals widespread clock disagreement.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

panels.title: Close Time Resolution Direction
panels.description:
**What:** Whether close-time resolution coarsened, sharpened, or held steady versus the previous ledger.
**How it's computed:** Latest direction outcome plotted per round, per node.
**Reading it:** Mostly unchanged with occasional sharpening is healthy.
**Healthy range:** Predominantly unchanged.
**Watch for:** Repeated coarsening indicates worsening agreement round over round.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

panels.title: Close Time Bin Distribution
panels.description:
**What:** How raw proposed close times spread across the quantized buckets each round.
**How it's computed:** Count of proposals landing in each bucket, stacked per round.
**Reading it:** A single dominant bar means strong clock agreement.
**Healthy range:** One dominant bucket per round.
**Watch for:** Spread across many buckets points to clock drift or network latency between validators.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::doAccept

panels.title: Consensus Outcome Distribution
panels.description:
**What:** Share of consensus outcomes: normal agreement, moved on without full agreement, or expired (timed out).
**How it's computed:** Total counts per outcome over a 5-minute window, shown as proportions.
**Reading it:** The normal outcome should dominate overwhelmingly.
**Healthy range:** Nearly all normal.
**Watch for:** A growing moved-on or expired slice indicates network stress or instability.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::makeAcceptSpan

targets.expr: sum by (consensus_state) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.accept", consensus_state!=""}[5m]))

panels.title: Consensus Failures Over Time
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of non-normal consensus outcomes (moved on plus expired) over time.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate of each failure outcome over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should sit at or near zero.
**Healthy range:** Effectively zero on a stable network.
**Watch for:** Spikes indicate consensus instability; sustained failures warrant investigation.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::makeAcceptSpan

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.accept", consensus_state="moved_on"}[5m]))

sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.accept", consensus_state="expired"}[5m]))

panels.title: Consensus Round Duration (Full Round)
panels.description:
**What:** End-to-end duration of a complete consensus round, filterable by consensus mode.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of full-round durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** The single most important consensus-health signal; watch the trend.
**Healthy range:** Roughly 3-6 seconds on mainnet.
**Watch for:** Rising round time precedes validated-ledger-age alarms and points to convergence trouble.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::startRoundTracing

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.round"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", consensus_mode=~"$consensus_mode", span_name="consensus.round"}[5m])))

panels.title: Consensus Phase Duration (Open vs Establish)
panels.description:
**What:** Duration of the open phase (collecting transactions) versus the establish phase (converging on a proposal), which together make up a round.
**How it's computed:** 95th percentile of each phase's duration over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Compare the two to see whether slowness is in gathering transactions or reaching agreement.
**Healthy range:** Open phase near the close interval; establish phase typically shorter.
**Watch for:** A ballooning establish phase means slow convergence; a long open phase means delayed close.
**Source:** src/xrpld/consensus/Consensus.h:Consensus::phaseOpen, Consensus::phaseEstablish

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.phase.open"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.establish"}[5m])))

panels.title: Position Update Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Time spent each round tallying disputes and updating this node's consensus position.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of per-round durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Grows with the number of disputed transactions being reconciled.
**Healthy range:** A few milliseconds under normal conditions.
**Watch for:** Long durations indicate heavy dispute resolution or slow convergence on close time.
**Source:** src/xrpld/consensus/Consensus.h:Consensus::updateOurPositions

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.update_positions"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.update_positions"}[5m])))

panels.title: Consensus Stall Rate
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of consensus health checks reporting a stalled condition versus progressing normally.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate split by stalled flag over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** The stalled line should stay at zero.
**Healthy range:** Zero stalled checks.
**Watch for:** Any sustained stalled rate surfaces a stall before it becomes a validated-ledger-age alarm.
**Source:** src/xrpld/consensus/Consensus.h:Consensus::haveConsensus

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.check", consensus_stalled="true"}[5m]))

sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.check", consensus_stalled="false"}[5m]))

panels.title: Consensus Mode-Change Rate by Target Mode
panels.description:
**What:** Rate of consensus mode transitions, split by the mode the node switched into.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate per target mode over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** A stable node changes mode rarely; occasional switches around startup are normal.
**Healthy range:** Near zero once synced.
**Watch for:** Frequent switches into Wrong Ledger or Switched Ledger mark an unstable node at fork risk.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onModeChange

targets.expr: sum by (mode_new, service_instance_id) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="consensus.mode_change"}[5m]))
